# Copilot Instructions for Zana Phase 1

This file tracks the workspace setup and development checklist for Zana Phase 1.

## Checklist
- [ ] Clarify Project Requirements
- [ ] Scaffold the Project
- [ ] Customize the Project
- [ ] Install Required Extensions
- [ ] Compile the Project
- [ ] Create and Run Task
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete

Update this file as you complete each step.

---

## Project Overview

Zana Phase 1 is a cloud-based POS, ERM, CRM, and Financial Helper system for African SMEs. It includes:
- Node.js Express backend (JWT, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker)
- React.js frontend (Tailwind CSS, mobile-first)
- Python FastAPI microservice (AI/forecasting)
- Dockerized deployment
- Mobile-optimized access
- Multi-language and local currency support
- Secure authentication and RBAC

---

Refer to this checklist and update progress as you work through the setup and development steps.
